description: Remove a member from the server. They can rejoin with a new invite (unlike a ban). Requires the Kick Members permission, and the bot's top role must be higher than the target's. Use discord_ban_member to block re-entry. The reason is recorded in the audit log.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the member to kick.

name: discord_kick_member
